name: Cyberpunk 2027
description: Out October 20, 2026 as That Boy Hi Hat's flagship pre-release single, "Cyberpunk 2027" is the most ambitious record in the catalog to date. Produced by Kokurcho and executive co-produced by Black Lansky, and recorded at Cue Recording Studios in Falls Church, Virginia, it arrives with real studio weight behind it — and it sounds like it. The production is cinematic production at scale: synth-heavy and synth-driven, layered and atmospheric, with an 808-driven undercurrent that keeps the future rooted in the streets. Atmospheric pads stretch across the mix like weather, a dark synth lead cuts through in the chorus, crisp hi-hats and hard-hitting drums drive the pocket throughout, and a bassline rolls underneath like a machine idling. Ad-libs stack thick around the hook, giving the whole thing a widescreen sound that feels built for a theater. That Boy Hi Hat moves through the dystopian landscape with total command — nocturnal imagery, a future that feels twelve months away, a hook that lands like a transmission. The mood is dark, cinematic, futuristic, and unapologetically dystopian. For fans of alt rap elevated to cinema, it sounds like the title sequence of a film that hasn't been made yet; it recalls the great world-building records of post trap while sitting firmly in the vein of That Boy Hi Hat's own post-trap futurism era. As the lead single of the Cyberpunk 2027 campaign, this is the record the entire catalog points toward — arriving October 20, 2026, and built to last.
